Package com.example.releasethekraken.model

Class EventRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.releasethekraken.model.EventRepository
public class EventRepository extends Object
Repository class responsible for creating, retrieving, and deleting Event objects from Firestore. This class handles all direct interactions with the "events" collection in the database.

      posterImageUrl - The url of the poster that is being deleted.
      callback - The callback being used to notify the caller of success or failure.
